terminals.name: backend
terminals.description: FastAPI backend API. Serves http://localhost:8000 with interactive docs at /docs. RAG endpoints (/rag/*) need PINECONE_API_KEY (and optionally GEMINI_API_KEY); core /analyze endpoints work without any keys.

terminals.description: Expo/Metro bundler for the React Native app. Scan the QR code with Expo Go or press a/i for an emulator.
